'''Poakie''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Sizzribb]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Enjoys drifting in the hot springs at the foot of a volcano. Sometimes gets pushed along by the sizzling bubbles before realizing the surroundings have changed."

Poakie is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
An orange and red tadpole with a white underside and yellow eyes. Its has dark brown, horizontal slit pupils.

Poakie's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its eyes and tail fin to blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Poakie's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Sizzribb]] you need to complete the following task:

* Feed Poakie 10 Spicy Sodas.

== Trivia ==
* Poakie and its evolutions were added to the game on 07/15/2026 alongside [[Hychroma]] and [[Ecstamira]].
